desc:
🚨 Welcome to Rescue City.
Ready to save lives and fight crime? Rescue City needs you!

👮 Become a police officer, chase down criminals, investigate crimes, and keep the city safe.
🚒 Join the fire department, battle fires, and rescue people from dangerous situations.
🚑 Work as an emergency medic, treat injured people, and respond to life-threatening emergencies.

🎯 Take on a variety of exciting missions!
From robberies and building fires to medical emergencies and serious accidents, every call brings a new challenge. Play solo, team up with friends, or tackle emergencies alongside our intelligent AI.

🇩🇪 Explore a detailed German-inspired map!
Discover varied locations, realistic streets, and plenty of places to explore as you make your way to the next emergency.

🚨 Respond to calls, assess the situation, and put your skills to the test.
🤝 Work together to handle challenging emergencies.
💰 Complete missions to earn money and XP as you progress in your chosen role.
